candidate_program.name: active_dispersion_interpolation
candidate_program.rationale: Uses active mean reward relative to the active maximum to adjust the blend of count and weight-normalized pressure, retaining at least seventy-five percent count influence. Reaches the whole active set through aggregates; repeated linear scans may consume construction time.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.75 * degree + 0.25 * (active_weight_flatness * degree + (1 - active_weight_flatness) * conflict_weight / (1 + weight)))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
